preregistration.criteria: sha256 of the dirty files recorded before and after the refused removal; the removal command's exit code recorded.

original#56 [2026-09-23T00:45:42.268Z]: WT=$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin/wt
cd $HOME/.cache/gap-wave2-20260923/isolation/worktrunk/owned-repo
WORKTREE_DIR=../owned-repo.feat-a
echo "dirty-uncommitted" > "$WORKTREE_DIR/dirty.txt"
echo "modified" >> "$WORKTREE_DIR/file.txt"
sha_dirty=$(sha256sum "$WORKTREE_DIR/dirty.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
sha_file=$(sha256sum "$WORKTREE_DIR/file.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "sha_dirty=$sha_dirty sha_file=$sha_file"
echo "== attempt remove dirty worktree =="
$WT -y -C "$WORKTREE_DIR" remove 2>&1
echo "exit=$?"
ls -la "$WORKTREE_DIR" 2>&1
sha_dirty2=$(sha256sum "$WORKTREE_DIR/dirty.txt" 2>&1 | cut -d' ' -f1)
sha_file2=$(sha256sum "$WORKTREE_DIR/file.txt" 2>&1 | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo "post: sha_dirty2=$sha_dirty2 sha_file2=$sha_file2"
[[ "$sha_dirty" == "$sha_dirty2" && "$sha_file" == "$sha_file2" ]] && echo "PRESERVED_BYTE_IDENTICAL=true" || echo "PRESERVED_BYTE_IDENTICAL=false"
